sql: with s as materialized (select event_ticker ev, market_ticker mk, captured_at t, minutes_to_close mtc, mid_cents mid, yes_ask_cents ask, yes_bid_cents bid, spot from crypto_ladder_snapshots where event_ticker >= $$KXBTCD-26OCT15$$ and event_ticker < $$KXBTCD-26OCT16$$ and strike_type = $$greater$$), caps as (select ev, t, max(spot) spot from s where spot is not null group by ev, t), dec as (select distinct on (ev, mk) ev, mk, t, mtc, mid, ask, bid from s where mtc between 20 and 40 and mid between 15 and 85 order by ev, mk, abs(mtc-30), t), fin as (select distinct on (mk) mk, mid fmid, mtc fmtc from s where mtc <= 2 order by mk, t desc), j as (select d.*, c.spot s0, (select c2.spot from caps c2 where c2.ev = d.ev and c2.t between d.t - interval $$18 min$$ and d.t - interval $$12 min$$ order by abs(extract(epoch from (d.t - c2.t)) - 900) limit 1) s15, f.fmid from dec d join caps c on c.ev = d.ev and c.t = d.t left join fin f on f.mk = d.mk) select to_char(t, $$MMDD$$) || $$|$$ || coalesce(round((10000*ln(s0/s15))::numeric, 1)::text, $$$$) || $$|$$ || round(mid::numeric,1) || $$|$$ || round(ask::numeric,1) || $$|$$ || round(bid::numeric,1) || $$|$$ || coalesce(round(fmid::numeric,1)::text, $$$$) || $$|$$ || ev as r from j order by t
